purpose: Challenge the selected point-in-time profit-versus-revenue acceleration rank gap against the complete 99-definition terminal library before any Campaign068 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_profit_revenue_acceleration_rank_gap_2r
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A positive gap between profit-growth acceleration rank and revenue-growth acceleration rank represents improving operating leverage or margin momentum that may remain under-repriced over three sessions.
selected_mechanism.formula: r_profit_yoy_acceleration-r_revenue_yoy_acceleration after same-fiscal-quarter differencing, strict-next-session availability, independent state propagation, and separate same-session average-tie percentile ranks on the common finite two-field cross-section.

overlap_challenges.reason: The two direct factors measure each acceleration level separately. Holding their rank difference fixed while shifting both ranks together changes either direct level but not the candidate; reversing their ordering changes the candidate sign. Both exposed inputs remain mandatory numerical confounds.

Campaign058 and the quality level factors depend on current already-effective growth levels. Campaign068 differences each growth field against the same fiscal quarter one year earlier before forming the signed cross-sectional contrast; equal current levels can coexist with different accelerations and vice versa.
Campaign068 reads no ROE and does not reward three-level agreement. Its score is a signed two-growth-acceleration contrast, not profitability change or a rank-range complement.

Campaign067 contrasts current ROE rank with absolute net-profit rank. Campaign068 reads neither ROE nor net_profit and contrasts year-over-year changes in two growth rates. The shared subtraction operator does not make the economic state or inputs identical.

Dates determine only when the acceleration state becomes available. Holding source growth histories fixed while changing allowed timing leaves the candidate value unchanged once effective; holding timing fixed while changing histories changes it.
Campaign068 reads no minute open, high, low, close, return, range, gap, body, wick, entropy, spectral, profile, reversal, or extreme field. Its state changes only after a new eligible disclosure.
Campaign068 reads no minute volume, amount, transaction price, VWAP, activity clock, or price-discovery path.
No market path, leave-one-out benchmark, beta, correlation, return dispersion, or peer price response enters the formula.

Candidate49 remains the sole prospective mechanism and counts causal close-versus-cumulative-VWAP crossings. Campaign068 is historical-only PIT accounting research and never reads or backfills Candidate49 returns, signals, or executions.

Only the two named, pre-existing acceleration definitions are combined with fixed coefficients +1/-1. No other terminal factor value, fitted weight, threshold, subset, regime, year, board, or model is selected.

counterfactual_checks.meaning: The candidate measures a relative acceleration gap rather than common acceleration level.
The score distinguishes profit acceleration outrunning revenue acceleration from the reverse.
The candidate is genuinely second-order rather than a restatement of current operating leverage.
The candidate cannot reproduce intraday mechanisms.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.acceleration_rule: same instrument and report month first difference after stable report-date ordering
design_choices_frozen_before_values.availability: first accepted session strictly after announcement_date
design_choices_frozen_before_values.state_propagation: independent per acceleration field inside instrument

decision.next_action: Freeze the Campaign068 no-return protocol, compact-cache manifest binding, feature implementation, audit implementation, and tests before reading any Campaign068 value.
